name: @libraz/suzume
description: Lightweight Japanese tokenizer with POS tagging, lemmatization, and keyword extraction for browser and Node.js

scripts.lint: biome check js/ tests/ && biome check --config-path ../../examples/ts/biome.json ../../examples/ts/
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write js/ tests/ && biome check --write --config-path ../../examples/ts/biome.json ../../examples/ts/
scripts.format: biome format --write js/ tests/ && biome format --write --config-path ../../examples/ts/biome.json ../../examples/ts/
scripts.test:examples: yarn build:js && node --experimental-strip-types ../../examples/ts/basic.ts && node --experimental-strip-types ../../examples/ts/search_indexer.ts && node --experimental-strip-types ../../examples/ts/tags.ts && node --experimental-strip-types ../../examples/ts/user_dictionary.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: yarn clean && yarn build && yarn lint && yarn test

author: libraz <libraz@libraz.net>
